2. This is an application seeking to quash the First Information Report in Crime No.225 of 2023 registered with the Dhantoli Police Station, Nagpur City for the offence punishable under Sections 120-B, 420, 465, 468, 471 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The informant was keen to take loan for which he has contacted co-accused Mr. Ajay Lanjewar.
In turn, Mr. Lanjewar took the informant to the concerned Bank, got filled all loan documents, but later on stated that proposal was not forwarded.

After few years, the informant came to know that his loan proposal was accepted, amount was disbursed in her account and then it was routed to the account of co-accused Mr. Lanjewar through Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) mode.
It is the informant case that she has been cheated by Mr. Lanjewar in connivance with the applicant (Branch Manager) and Loan Officer Shri Kapse, therefore the 2 3.apl.972.2023 report.
4. The learned Counsel for the applicant would submit that the entire allegations revolves around co- accused Mr.Lanjewar.
